news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: ClearPoint's partner Aspen Neuroscience received FDA RMAT designation for sasineprocel, an investigational autologous cell therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula in the ASPIRO trial.

news.headline: BlackRock discloses 7.1% beneficial stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: A Schedule 13G/A filing shows BlackRock now holds 2,118,912 shares (7.1%) of ClearPoint Neuro as a passive institutional investor, adding a large new index-style holder alongside existing backers like MAK Capital and Bigger Capital.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results August 3, 2026
news.source: The Globe and Mail / ACCESS Newswire
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close on August 3, 2026, followed by a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: EpilepsyGTx Partners with ClearPoint Neuro to Support Targeted Delivery of Lead Gene Therapy in Epilepsy
news.summary: EpilepsyGTx will use ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation System to deliver its lead gene therapy candidate EPY201 in an upcoming first-in-human Phase 1/2a trial for focal refractory epilepsy, adding another biopharma partner to ClearPoint's drug-delivery ecosystem.

news.headline: B. Riley raises ClearPoint Neuro price target to $30 from $20, keeps Buy
news.summary: B. Riley analyst Anderson Schock raised his price target on ClearPoint Neuro to $30 from $20 while reiterating a Buy rating, citing the platform-validating implications of the FDA's stance on partner uniQure's AMT-130 program.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro shares surge as FDA clears accelerated-approval path for partner uniQure's AMT-130
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro shares jumped roughly 26-50% intraday after partner uniQure disclosed that an FDA Type B meeting confirmed its three-year Phase I/II data can support a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, with submission planned for Q3 2026; AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro reports second-quarter 2026 results after market close with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET; investors will watch for progress toward full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $52M-$56M, margin trajectory, and updated commentary on the uniQure AMT-130 opportunity.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission for Huntington's disease
catalysts.detail: Following an FDA Type B meeting confirming that three-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA, partner uniQure plans to submit the filing in Q3 2026. AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula, making regulatory progress here a direct validation of ClearPoint's delivery-device business.

catalysts.label: Aspen Neuroscience sasineprocel next regulatory steps
catalysts.detail: Following its July 31 RMAT designation, faster FDA interactions or an eventual BLA for Aspen's Parkinson's cell therapy (delivered via ClearPoint's platform) are plausible but no formal filing date has been announced.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx first-in-human EPY201 trial start
catalysts.detail: EpilepsyGTx's upcoming Phase 1/2a trial for focal refractory epilepsy will use ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation System; trial initiation would mark a new clinical use case beyond Huntington's disease.

catalysts.label: Broader biopharma partner pipeline milestones
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's device/navigation revenue is tied to a roster of 60+ biopharma partners running gene- and cell-therapy programs that use its SmartFlow and navigation systems; regulatory or clinical readouts at these partners remain a recurring catalyst for ClearPoint's per-case, biologics, and IRRAflow revenue streams.

catalysts.label: Velocity Alpha and international rollout continuing
catalysts.detail: Following 2026 FDA clearance and first clinical use of the Velocity Alpha MR surgical drill system and a new 10-year focused-ultrasound development partnership with Sungkyunkwan University (South Korea), continued commercial rollout and additional international regulatory clearances remain an ongoing growth driver.

pulse: With Q2 2026 results due tomorrow, August 3 after market close, ClearPoint Neuro remains buoyed by partner uniQure's June 17 disclosure that the FDA will accept three-year AMT-130 Huntington's data for an accelerated-approval BLA (planned Q3 2026 submission), a validating event that sent CLPT shares sharply higher and drove a price-target hike from B. Riley to $30. The company continues to broaden its biopharma partner base, signing EpilepsyGTx in July for a first-in-human epilepsy gene-therapy trial and seeing partner Aspen Neuroscience win FDA RMAT designation for its Parkinson's cell therapy, while BlackRock's late-July Schedule 13G/A disclosed a fresh 7.1% passive stake, adding a large new institutional holder. The core thesis remains ClearPoint's role as the neuro-navigation and delivery-device partner across 60+ biopharma gene- and cell-therapy programs, with uniQure's regulatory progress the clearest near-term proof point heading into Monday's earnings print, where investors will watch progress toward full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $52M-$56M.
